description: This file is a PHP source file for the vtiger CRM module 'PriceBooks'. It handles the retrieval and display of detailed view information for PriceBook records, including user permissions, related lists, and template assignments.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: CRMEntity class represents the core entity model in vtiger CRM, providing methods to instantiate and retrieve record information.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Vtiger_Link handles the creation and retrieval of various types of links within vtiger CRM, such as related links used in detail views.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the CRMEntity instance for a given module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific record of the module.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves the display blocks for a module's detail view.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Gets the parent tab or category for the current module.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific actions on records.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Returns the tab ID associated with a module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Retrieves validation rules for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits raw validation data into structured arrays.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds related module info to session storage.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules stored in session.

methods.name: isPresentRelatedLists
methods.description: Checks if the current module has related lists.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves boolean preferences for performance tuning.

methods.name: getListViewNavigation
methods.description: Provides navigation info for list view records.

methods.name: VT_detailViewNavigation
methods.description: Populates navigation controls in detail view.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of specified types for the module.
